title: Ecosystem
intro: Asmoday only does files, media and terminals. Everything below is delegated to mature tools through WebDAV or a shared directory.

items.syncthing: Peer-to-peer incremental sync. Mirror folders from your phone or desktop straight into an Asmoday mount.
items.photosync: Back up your phone camera roll in the background over the WebDAV endpoint Asmoday provides.
items.foldersync: A capable Android folder sync tool that can mirror specific directories over WebDAV on a schedule.
items.qbittorrent: A battle-tested BitTorrent client. Point its download path at an Asmoday cinema folder and play the result in the browser.
items.aria2: A lightweight multi-protocol command-line downloader, a great fit with AriaNg.
items.caddy: Exposing Asmoday to the internet? Pair it with a proper reverse proxy; X-Forwarded-* headers are supported natively.
items.tailscale: Prefer not to expose anything? Build a virtual LAN and reach your devices safely from anywhere.
items.picgo: Point PicGo at Asmoday's direct image URLs and combine it with Typora or Obsidian for a self-hosted Markdown workflow.

footer: Asmoday grows thanks to the open-source and commercial tools above. Click any card to visit its official site.
